scores.criterion: 1. Hook (first 125 chars state what, standout fact, where)
scores.evidence: The first line is 111 characters ('Новый мини-пентхаус в Кохав ха-Цафон, Тель-Авив: 76 м² террас на 11-м этаже из 12, в двух шагах от парка Яркон.') and clearly states property type, 76 m² terraces, floor 11/12, neighborhood, and landmark.

scores.criterion: 2. Location stated plainly in line 1 (neighbourhood + north Tel Aviv + landmark)
scores.evidence: Line 1 of the post states 'Кохав ха-Цафон, Тель-Авив' and 'парка Яркон', while line 1 on the 4:5 Cover and Reel explicitly states 'Кохав ха-Цафон, север Тель-Авива' alongside Yarkon Park.

scores.criterion: 3. Specific numbers (built m², terrace m², rooms, floor 11 of 12, new boutique building, no puffery)
scores.evidence: States '5 комнат', 'около 197 м²', '76 м² террас', '11-й этаж из 12', and 'в новом бутиковом доме' without relying on empty adjectives.

scores.criterion: 4. Real media of the actual home (nothing generated/rendered presented as the home)
scores.evidence: Photos and video frames are real shots labeled 'Снято в квартире'; the 3D floorplan on Card 4 is explicitly labeled 'Визуализация по плану архитектора' both on the card and in the post text.

scores.criterion: 5. Feed frame (lead 4:5, Reel 9:16 with text outside top 14%, bottom 35%, 6% sides)
scores.evidence: Lead cover is 4:5 and Reel frames are 9:16; all primary text in the Reel sits safely below the top 14% (~14.5% to 32% from top) and well above the bottom 35% UI zone.

scores.criterion: 6. Vertical video exists (Reel cut in addition to photo album)
scores.evidence: A 22-second 9:16 vertical Reel cut is provided alongside the 4:5 cover and six 1:1 album cards.

scores.criterion: 7. Human on camera or named voice (Meital or named person appears or speaks)
scores.evidence: No human appears on camera in any of the Reel frames or cards, and there is no script, captions, or indication of a named voiceover.

scores.criterion: 8. Story before the spec sheet (what living there feels like before facts)
scores.evidence: Paragraph 2 ('Утренний кофе с видом на силуэт Тель-Авива, вечера с друзьями на террасе.') precedes the bulleted spec sheet; Reel at 15s also includes 'Для долгих вечеров с барбекю в кругу друзей'.
Post text includes the exact Hebrew legal line: 'מיטל קציר, מתווכת במקרקעין, רישיון 3131540', plus Russian/English equivalents on all visual assets.

scores.criterion: 10. Price rule (legal: omitted or shekel total ₪18,000,000, never foreign currency only)
scores.evidence: Shown in the post text with the shekel total leading: 'Цена: 18 000 000 ₪ (около 5,9 млн $ / 5,1 млн €)', and omitted on visual cards.

scores.criterion: 11. One clear CTA (one action, not three)
scores.evidence: Single clear action to book a private showing via phone/WhatsApp with Meital at +972 52-363-1582.

scores.criterion: 12. Sound-off (Reel understood muted through on-screen text)
scores.evidence: Every Reel scene features prominent, high-contrast Russian headlines, subheads, and a progress bar that communicate the full value proposition without audio.
Exactly 4 relevant hashtags placed cleanly at the end: #ТельАвив #Пентхаус #НедвижимостьИзраиля #НедвижимостьТельАвива.

scores.criterion: 14. Owner consent and freshness (legal: exclusivity consent on file + removal plan)
scores.evidence: While 'эксклюзив' is stated in the text and end card, no evidence of written owner consent on file or a takedown/update SLA upon sale is provided in the submission.

scores.criterion: 15. No external link in Facebook post body (link only in first comment)
scores.evidence: The post body contains no URLs and directs readers to the first comment, which holds the UTM-tagged link.

scores.criterion: 16. Groups by hand, each one different (no automated/identical group blasts)
scores.evidence: Only one generic Facebook text is submitted; there are no group-adapted text variants or distribution schedule provided.

scores.criterion: 17. No duplicate blasts across accounts (distinct wording per Page/X account)
scores.evidence: The Facebook post and the X (SHORT TEXT) version use distinct wording, structure, and platform-specific UTM parameters.

scores.criterion: 18. X version (≤280 chars counting link as 23, text-led, link in body with context)
scores.evidence: Counting the URL as 23 characters, the SHORT TEXT is 246 characters (222 text + 1 space + 23 link), text-led, and includes full context.

scores.criterion: Internal note: Meital presented as listing broker and nad-lan as publisher (never broker)
scores.evidence: Meital Katzir (Nadlan Al HaYam, license 3131540) is consistently credited as the broker on every card, frame, and text, while nad-lan.co.il is only shown as the website domain/publisher.

hook_verdict: Strong, award-caliber factual hook: at 111 characters, it beats the 125-character truncation threshold and immediately anchors the property type (new mini-penthouse), the #1 quantitative differentiator (76 m² of terraces on floor 11 of 12), and the exact micro-location + landmark (Kochav HaTzafon, steps from Yarkon Park).
strongest: Exemplary visual and textual transparency ('Снято в квартире' vs. 'Визуализация по плану архитектора'), which builds immediate trust in the luxury segment.
Strict adherence to Meta Reel safe zones (all text sits cleanly between 14% and 32% from the top, avoiding both top UI and the bottom 35% caption/CTA overlay).
Disciplined information architecture: zero puffery, complete legal broker disclosure in both Russian and statutory Hebrew, and clean organic link separation into the first comment.

fixes.what: Add Meital Katzir on camera for a 2–3 second intro hook in the Reel (or add her named voiceover with burned-in captions).
fixes.why: Criterion 7 fails: agent-led Reels drive significantly higher engagement and trust in luxury real estate than faceless pan-and-zoom slideshow cuts.

fixes.what: Document the owner exclusivity consent and post-sale takedown protocol, and supply 2–3 tailored copy variants if sharing to Facebook Groups.
fixes.why: Criteria 14 and 16 cannot be verified from a single post copy alone and are required for legal compliance and Meta anti-spam safety.

fixes.what: Explicitly add the word 'север' ('на севере Тель-Авива') into Line 1 of the Facebook post body (currently in Line 2, though present on the Cover and Reel).
fixes.why: Tightens Criterion 2 compliance in the raw text hook to match the Cover card's exact geographic framing before truncation.
